lines.zh: 第五十号奔尸，一路小跑。

lines.en: My ankle is bent and I still run.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，等你自己摔倒。
lines.en: I watch you and wait for you to trip.

lines.zh: 我看清了，你只有一个人。
lines.en: I see it clearly — you are alone.

lines.zh: 一个活人，够我追半条街。
lines.en: One living soul, enough to chase half a street.

lines.zh: 向玩家发起攻击，嘶吼连连。

lines.en: My leg feels like it's breaking.
The pain is like a刀割.
Hungry, want to eat something tasty.

lines.zh: 饿得肠子贴脊梁，快给我肉！
lines.en: Hunger pins my guts to my spine. Give me meat!
Watch out! Don't collide with me.

lines.zh: 撞开你，我就能咬到脖子！
lines.en: Knock you aside and I can reach your neck!

lines.zh: 让开！我这条腿停不下来！
lines.en: Move! This leg of mine won't stop!

lines.zh: 我撞开你，就为了一口肉。
lines.en: I shove you aside for a single bite of meat.

lines.zh: 别贴过来，我身上的咬痕会传给你。
lines.en: Do not press close; these bite marks spread.
Get lost; don't spoil my kill!
I run faster than you. Do not try.

lines.zh: 同样的伤口，才认得彼此。
lines.en: Only the same wounds recognize each other.

lines.zh: 五十号这身皮，也想找伴。
我还会伸手，像从前那样。
lines.en: I still reach out, the way I used to.

lines.zh: 趁我还没烂透，得留个种！
lines.en: Before I rot through, I should leave something behind!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶响着，蠕动着向前爬行。

lines.en: Feasting on the ground, searching for food.

lines.zh: 咬向猎物的脚踝，尝试拖走。
lines.en: Biting at the prey's ankle, trying to drag it away.
Sibilant and lapping at the wound.
Biting into the bone, savoring the taste.

lines.zh: 啃食腐烂的尸体，满足饥饿。
lines.en: Feasting on the rotting corpse, satisfying hunger.
Fixing on the prey, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶响着，慢慢接近目标。
lines.en: Sibilant and inching closer to the target.
Feasting on the prey, not letting go.
Sibilant and tearing at the prey.

lines.zh: 发现了活人，嘶嘶叫着接近。
lines.en: Spotting a living person, sibilant and creeping closer.

lines.zh: 发现了食物，嘶嘶叫着追踪。
lines.en: Spotting food, sibilant and tracking it.

lines.zh: 发现了猎物，嘶嘶叫着靠近。
lines.en: Spotting the prey, sibilant and creeping near.

lines.zh: 发现了目标，嘶嘶叫着锁定。
lines.en: Spotting the target, sibilant and locking on.

lines.zh: 发现了猎物，嘶嘶叫着包围。
lines.en: Spotting the prey, sibilant and closing in.

lines.zh: 发现了活人，嘶嘶叫着靠近。
lines.en: Spotting a living person, sibilant and creeping near.

lines.zh: 发现了猎物，嘶嘶叫着接近。
lines.en: Spotting the prey, sibilant and creeping closer.

lines.zh: 发现了猎物，嘶嘶叫着扑击。
lines.en: Spotting the prey, sibilant and lunging.

lines.zh: 活人的气味，隔墙也闻得到。
lines.en: Living scent, even through a wall.
This whole area is my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 不管哪个群系，我都能闻到。
lines.en: No matter the biome, I catch the scent.

lines.zh: 被咬过的人，跑得比我慢。
lines.en: The bitten always run slower than me.
You limp, and I keep pace.

lines.zh: 尸变的味道，也是我留的。
lines.en: That reek of turning is my doing too.
Sibilant and locking on to the target.

lines.zh: 被咬过的伤口，已经不治。
lines.en: The bite wound no longer heals.
Sibilant and biting at the target.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着，试图咬住目标。
lines.en: Sibilant and trying to bite the target.
Sibilant and tearing at the target.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着，锁定并咬住目标。
lines.en: Sibilant and locking on and biting the target.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着，咬向目标的脚。
lines.en: Sibilant and biting at the target's foot.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着，咬向目标的手。
lines.en: Sibilant and biting at the target's hand.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着，咬向目标的腿。
lines.en: Sibilant and biting at the target's leg.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着，咬向目标的脖子。
lines.en: Sibilant and biting at the target's neck.
Don't run straight. I never stop.
One bite and you can't run anymore.
I'm counting the step where you trip.
The blood on your hands is fresher than mine.
The more you panic, the more you run into me.
Lunge at you, rip your flesh!
I sink my teeth into your forearm!
My nails dig into your forearm.
I bite your ankle down to the bone.
After this bite, there is no cure.
I pin you down and bite first, think later.
I want to run too, but my leg is broken.

lines.zh: 废楼底下，尸变的那个站起。
lines.en: Under the ruined building, the turned one stands.
Variant fifty's face, rotted just right.
I claw my way out of the pile of corpses.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我也该出来跑了。
lines.en: It's dark, so it's time for me to run.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，皮肉都开了。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and splits my flesh.

lines.zh: 饥饿开始侵蚀我的肉体。
雷劈在我头顶，焦味冲鼻。
lines.en: Lightning hits my skull and the stink of char fills my nose.
